note: Hand-labelled evaluation set for ReguLens AI deterministic engines. Sentences 1-12 are adapted from the public RBI Internal Ombudsman directions (paraphrased); the remainder are synthetic edge cases. Labels were assigned by the developer reading the engine's documented rules, then frozen before measurement.

extraction_sentences.sentence: Every bank shall appoint at least one IO.
The bank shall inform the Reserve Bank of India within 10 working days from the date of vacancy.
"Deficiency in service" means a shortcoming in any service the bank provides.
The Customer Service Committee of the Board shall determine, at least once in every year, the required IO strength.
These Directions shall be applicable to Commercial Banks having 10 or more banking outlets in India.
The bank should review complaint trends periodically for systemic issues.
Nothing in these Directions shall affect the jurisdiction of the courts.
The IO shall submit a quarterly report within 15 days of the end of each quarter.
Banks may publish additional customer education material on their websites.
The bank shall retain IO-related records for at least 5 years from final disposal.
For the avoidance of doubt, the 2023 Directions stand superseded for commercial banks.
All rejected complaints shall be escalated to the Internal Ombudsman before final communication.
The mechanism shall be reviewed at least once in every year for effectiveness.
